description: gatecall's hooks. At session start, one line naming the company's profile and its red folders (and, when the session itself runs on a provider the profile forbids, that every message will be stopped); a pass over the journal starts in the background: each record past the retention period of the folder it was written in is deleted, and a journal from 0.1.3 has its fingerprints signed again under each folder's key. Before a message leaves: a key, a card number (Luhn), an IBAN (mod-97), an ID number with its check digit, or a list of addresses or phone numbers stops it, with the reason in the person's language. Before a step: the same for commands, web requests and tool calls; red folders are read only by a model on this computer; gatecall's own journal and key are opened by gatecall alone, in a Bash or a PowerShell command too; kimi works only in a training folder, grok only on a cleaned copy, agy never gets a permission for everything. After a command, a file read, a search or an MCP tool: the company's journal key, wherever the step found it, is taken out of the output before Claude reads it. Every hook goes through the step 0 guard: with no Python the session start says so in one line, and the others stay quiet.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" gatecall say "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook start
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) gatecall say "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook start

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" gatecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook prompt
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) gatecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook prompt

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" gatecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook tool
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) gatecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook tool

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" gatecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook output
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) gatecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gatecall/scripts/gatecall.py" hook output
